items.title: Employment contracts should be in writing
items.core: Oral agreements are the most difficult to prove in disputes.
body: Confirm the contract subject, position and salary before joining.
Keep a signed original copy for yourself.
Within one month of joining, take the initiative to sign a written labor contract, clarifying the position, salary, working hours and contract period.
Refuse to only agree on salary verbally, and write all probation period wages, conditions for regularization, and overtime pay calculation methods into the contract.
After signing, keep an original copy for yourself. If the company refuses to sign, keep the work badge, attendance records and other materials proving the labor relationship.

Case: Xiao Zhang joined a small company. The boss verbally promised a monthly salary of 8,000 yuan but did not sign a written labor contract. After working for three months, the company was in arrears with wages. Xiao Zhang applied for arbitration. Since there was no written contract to prove the salary standards, it took a long time to recover part of the remuneration.

items.title: The probation period is not a free period
items.core: You must also sign a contract and pay wages during the probation period.
body: Confirm the probation period length and salary ratio.
Reasons must also be given for dismissal during the probation period.
The probation period must be included in the labor contract period. A contract that separately stipulates a probation period is invalid. Please confirm it carefully when signing.
The salary during the probation period shall not be less than 80% of the lowest salary for the same position in the unit, and shall not be lower than the local minimum wage standard.
If the company only agrees on a probation period but not on regular salary, the probation period shall be the term of the labor contract, and relevant communication records shall be retained.

Case: Xiao Li applied for a certain position, and the company said that there would be no salary during the probation period of one month, and only living expenses would be paid. After Xiao Li joined the company, he found that the regular salary for the same position was extremely low. He was dismissed at will during the probation period. Since he did not sign a contract and had no salary agreement, it was difficult to claim his legal rights.

items.title: Overtime work must be recorded
items.core: Without records, it is difficult to claim overtime pay.
body: Save schedule, clock-in and communication records.
Confirm the calculation method of overtime pay or compensated time off.
After each overtime work, timely save written evidence such as overtime approval forms, work group chat records, and late night punch-in records.
When working overtime, sort out the work content, record the overtime hours and specific tasks, and confirm the overtime facts to the leader via email.
Distinguish overtime work on working days, weekends and statutory holidays, and calculate overtime pay according to the wage standards of 1.5 times, 2 times and 3 times respectively.

Case: Xiao Wang often works overtime in a technology company until 9 p.m., and only reports on overtime work verbally without written records. After leaving his job, he claimed overtime pay, but the company refused to pay him because there was no overtime approval record. Xiao Wang failed to defend his rights due to lack of evidence.

items.title: Resignation certificate is required
items.core: It will affect the entry into the next job.
body: Request a certificate of termination when resigning.
Confirm social security and file transfer.
When the resignation handover is completed, ask for a resignation certificate from the company on the spot, confirming that the labor contract term, termination date and position are indicated.
The resignation certificate must be stamped with the company's official seal. If there is no official seal or the information is incomplete, request a new one in a timely manner and keep a copy.
If the company refuses to issue a certificate of resignation, you can complain to the labor inspection department, and you can ask the company to compensate for the loss of employment caused.

Case: Sister Chen resigned from her original company and hurriedly joined the new company without asking for a certificate of resignation. When applying for a job at the new company, she found that she lacked a resignation certificate. Worried about a non-competition dispute, she postponed the application process. Sister Chen was forced to return to the original company to make up for the new job, which was delayed for a week.

items.title: Try to keep paying social security as much as possible
items.core: Stop paying will affect your medical and home purchase qualifications.
body: Learn about the backpayment rules when changing jobs.
Keep payment records for future reference.
Confirm the date of joining the new company before resigning, and try to make social security payments as seamless as possible to avoid payment interruption months in the middle.

Within 3 months of the suspension of social security payments, you can consult the local social security department to apply for supplementary payments. You may lose your qualifications for reimbursement the following month after the suspension of medical payments.
During the flexible employment period, continue to pay employee social security as an individual to avoid affecting medical insurance reimbursement and house and car purchase qualifications.

Case: When Mr. Zhang left his job and failed to pay social security for 3 months, he fell ill and was hospitalized. His medical insurance could not reimburse him, and he paid more than 20,000 yuan out of pocket. Moreover, due to the suspension of social security payments, he did not meet the local qualifications for paying for two consecutive years to buy a house, and missed the opportunity to buy a house.

items.title: The salary slip must be checked item by item
items.core: The salary slip is the basis for checking social security and personal income tax.
body: Reconfirm base salary, performance and deductions.
Report in the month when the abnormality is discovered.
After receiving the salary slip every month, check whether the basic salary, performance pay, overtime pay and other details are consistent with the contract.
Focus on checking the proportion and base of personal deductions for social security and provident fund, and whether special additional deductions for personal income tax are accurately reported.
If any abnormality in the salary slip is found, written feedback will be given to the human resources department within 3 working days, requiring a detailed explanation and retention of evidence.

Case: Ms. Liu never checked the salary slip she received every month. Half a year later, she discovered that the social security payment base was far lower than the actual salary, and the individual tax deduction items were also wrong. When checking with the company, because the problem was not discovered in time, it was difficult to adjust after the objection period, resulting in a loss of thousands of yuan.

items.title: Keep your own copy of the attendance record
items.core: Company records may not be complete when a dispute occurs.
body: Save punch-in screenshots and shift notifications.
Please leave as much text as possible when approving overtime work.
Take photos every day after work to record the clock-in interface and attendance machine time, or save positioning clock-in screenshots and work group sign-in information.
Compile attendance records once a week, mark working hours and overtime by date, and verify each other with colleagues’ attendance records.
If you find that the company's attendance records are inconsistent with the actual situation, promptly raise objections in writing, request corrections, and retain communication vouchers.

Case: Master Zhao works at a construction site, and the company keeps attendance records uniformly. When settling wages at the end of the year, the company undercalculated the work period by 10 days. Master Zhao had no personal attendance record and could not prove the actual working hours, so he ended up receiving 3,000 yuan less in wages.

items.title: Position transfer requires negotiation between both parties
items.core: The position is part of the contract.
body: Confirm the salary and location after the transfer.
Express in writing if you disagree.
The company needs to negotiate with the employees for job transfer and should confirm it in writing. When receiving the verbal job transfer notice, you can clearly refuse it.
Judge the rationality of the job transfer: whether the salary is reduced, whether commuting is convenient, and whether the nature of the position is related to the labor contract.
When forced to transfer, report to the new position but indicate "do not agree to the transfer", and collect transfer notices and salary change records at the same time.

Case: Ms. Li was originally an administrative supervisor. The company issued a transfer notice without consultation and transferred her to a sales position in a remote area. Her salary was significantly reduced. After Ms. Li refused to work, the company fired her for disobeying the arrangements. She proved through arbitration that the transfer was illegal and she received compensation.

items.title: The performance system must be transparent
items.core: The assessment standards should be clear in advance.
body: Ask for the assessment methods and weights.
Keep target confirmation records.
Ask for the performance appraisal system when you join the company and confirm whether the assessment indicators, scoring standards and bonus payment rules are clear and specific.
The company's adjustment of the performance appraisal system must go through democratic procedures and be publicized. Unpublicized systems cannot be used as the basis for assessment.
If there is any objection to the assessment results, a written review is required within the specified time, and the work results and performance data are retained as evidence.

Case: A company suddenly raised its performance standards during the year-end assessment. Employees who achieved 80% of the original goals were still rated as unqualified and their full-year performance bonuses were deducted. The employees discovered that the assessment standards had never been announced in advance, and it was difficult to claim bonuses because there was no clear institutional basis.

items.title: Clear the cost during the training service period
items.core: There is an upper limit on liquidated damages during the service period.
body: Confirm training costs and allocation rules.
Calculate the cost of early resignation before signing.
Check the training fee voucher. The liquidated damages shall not exceed the training fee allocated during the unfulfilled service period. The excess part may be refused to be paid.
Confirm the type of training. Only special technical training can agree on the service period. General induction training and safety training cannot agree on liquidated damages.
When signing a service period agreement, it is required to specify the training fee details, the start and end time of the service period, and the calculation method of liquidated damages.

Case: Engineer Wang participated in external technical training paid by the company and signed a service period agreement, agreeing on a 5-year service period and a liquidated damages of 100,000 yuan. After working for 2 years, he resigned. The company required him to pay 60,000 yuan in liquidated damages. Since the training cost was only 30,000 yuan, the liquidated damages exceeded the legal limit.

items.title: Compensation should be paid for non-compete restrictions
items.core: Compensation should be paid for restrictions on employment.
body: Confirm scope and deadline.
Unpaid compensation can be claimed for termination.
The non-competition period shall not exceed 2 years, and the company must pay compensation on a monthly basis, which shall not be less than 30% of the local minimum wage.
If the company fails to pay compensation as agreed for more than 3 months, the employee may terminate the non-compete agreement by giving a written notice and keep a record of delivery.
Clear the scope and region of competition when signing an agreement to avoid overly broad agreements that may affect re-employment. If the agreement exceeds a reasonable scope, it may be invalid.

Case: Internet engineer Xiao Zhang signed a non-compete agreement when he resigned, stipulating that he would not engage in related industries within 2 years, but the company did not pay any compensation. After Xiao Zhang joined the new company, the original company claimed for violation of non-competition restrictions, and arbitration determined that the agreement was invalid due to lack of compensation.

items.title: Annual leave is calculated based on accumulated service years
items.core: The number of vacation days is related to the service years.
body: Confirm the number of days of leave due.
Untaken annual leave will be compensated at a discount.

The number of annual leave days is calculated based on the cumulative length of service: 5 days for those who have more than 1 year but less than 10 years, 10 days for more than 10 years but less than 20 years, and 15 days for more than 20 years.
When joining a new unit, provide social security payment records, Previous labor contract and other materials to prove the cumulative working years.
The company does not arrange for annual leave, and the employee must be paid at 300% of the daily salary, of which the normal salary is included and needs to be supplemented by 200%.

Case: Mr. Wu has worked for a total of 12 years. The new company calculates annual leave based on the length of service in the unit and only gives 5 days of annual leave. Mr. Wu provided social security records to prove his accumulated service years and was entitled to 10 days of annual leave in accordance with the law. In the end, the company compensated for the remaining 5 days of annual leave.

items.title: Sick leave requires compliance certificate
items.core: The form of the certificate affects wages and benefits.
body: Provide diagnostic materials as required by the company.
Understand sick pay standards.

Priority is given to second-level and above hospitals to issue sick leave forms, which must include the diagnosis conclusion, recommended number of days of rest, and the doctor's signature. Community clinic certificates are usually not recognized by companies.

Submit a stamped diagnosis certificate within 3 days after the emergency visit. If you need to extend your leave, you must provide a follow-up visit record to avoid extending the leave based on verbal explanations from being deemed as personal leave.

When submitting a copy, indicate "This copy is only used for this sick leave application" and sign it. The original copy will be returned after verification by the company to prevent the certificate from being used for other purposes and affecting salary calculation.

Case: When Mr. Zhang, a programmer, was on sick leave, he only informed his supervisor via WeChat that he had not submitted a hospital certificate, and the company would deduct wages according to personal leave. After submitting a supplementary medical certificate, the company still refused to make up for the sick leave wages on the grounds that the compliance certificate was not submitted within the specified time.

items.title: Rights and interests during pregnancy are protected
items.core: Salary cannot be reduced or dismissed due to pregnancy.
body: Keep records of pregnancy check-ups.
Learn about maternity leave and breastfeeding time.

When encountering a job transfer or salary reduction, you must raise a written objection within 30 days of receiving the written notice and keep the express delivery voucher. Verbal agreement may be regarded as a tacit acceptance of the change.

Keep the pregnancy test registration form, B-ultrasound report and other medical records. If you are fired, you can claim for the restoration of labor relations or 2N compensation, and the pregnancy salary will be repaid in full according to the original standard.

When the contract expires, it will automatically be extended until the end of the lactation period. Unilateral termination by the company is illegal. The company may require continued performance of the contract or claim for compensation until the child reaches one year old.

Case: Ms. Li, who was 5 months pregnant, was transferred to the warehouse manager by the company on the grounds of "optimizing her position" and had her salary reduced by 30%. After she applied for labor arbitration, the ruling was to reinstate her original position and pay the difference in wages, and the company was ordered to make rectifications.

items.title: The collective contract covers all members
items.core: The contract signed by the labor union is valid for all employees.
body: Learn whether the position is suitable for you.
Individual contracts must not be lower than collective standards.

Check the contract coverage ranges: Check the employee roster announced by the trade union to confirm whether your position is within the agreed scope of application to avoid being treated differently by the company on the grounds of being a 'non-union member'.

Compare the collective contract with the individual contract: If the individual contract benefits are lower than the collective contract standards, you can directly quote the terms of the collective contract to make up the difference.

Pay attention to the contract validity process: the collective contract must be discussed and approved by the Workers’ Congress and submitted to the labor administration department for registration. Contracts that have not been registered cannot be directly used as a basis for rights protection.

Case: The labor union of a property company signed a collective contract with the employer, agreeing on a 5% salary increase for all employees, but HR only performed formal work. After finding out, Auntie Wang (labor dispatch), a cleaning lady, reported it to the union, and the union asked the company to repay the difference according to the contract.

items.title: Probation must be provided for dismissal during the probationary period
items.core: Cannot be terminated arbitrarily on the grounds of inappropriateness.
body: Ask for specific reasons.
If the reason is not established, you can apply for arbitration.

Enterprises need to provide probation period assessment standards and evidence of failure to meet the standards. For example, sales positions need to provide quarterly performance tables, customer visit records and other quantitative materials, and vague evaluations do not have legal effect.

Verify the legality of the termination procedure: Illegal dismissals must be notified to the labor union within 30 days after knowing the reason for termination. Failure to comply with this procedure may directly claim compensation.

Save the job description and assessment system when you join the company. If the company adds 'inappropriate' clauses afterwards, it can claim that the rules and regulations are invalid without democratic procedures.

Case: Xiao Liu, a newcomer to the sales position, was dismissed as "not suitable for the team culture" in the second month of his probation period without any evaluation record. The arbitral tribunal asked the company to provide evidence. Since it was unable to provide evidence, it ruled that the company had illegally terminated the company and paid compensation.

items.title: You can complain about wage arrears
items.core: There is a clear time limit for wage payment.
body: Use the warning first and keep records.
Report to the labor inspection.

Confirm the wage payment cycle: If the labor contract stipulates that wages will be paid on the 15th of each month, you can file a complaint if it is overdue for more than 7 days. Pay attention to retaining bank statements to prove the historical payment rules.

Prepare a list of complaint materials: copies of ID cards, labor contracts, attendance records, salary slips or bank transfer records. If any missing materials are missing, you can first apply to the labor inspection department for retrieval.

Distinguish between complaints and arbitration: Complaints to the supervisory department are suitable for quick recovery. If there is a dispute over compensation, you must apply for labor arbitration within one year of knowing that your rights and interests have been damaged.

Case: After the decoration team completed the project, the contractor owed five workers a total of 80,000 yuan in wages for three months. The workers complained to the labor inspection brigade, and the inspection department ordered the company to pay within 3 days. Overdue compensation will be increased by 50%, and the full amount will be paid in the end.

items.title: Labor disputes must be negotiated first and then arbitrated
items.core: Only by clear procedures can we avoid detours.
body: Organize evidence and timeline.
Pay attention to the arbitration statute of limitations.

Send a written letter during the negotiation stage: clarify the appeal and rectification deadline (such as repayment of wages within 3 days), send it via EMS and retain the receipt as evidence of time limit interruption.

Mediation organization selection: You can apply for free mediation to the enterprise labor dispute mediation committee or the street labor and social security office. If you reach an agreement, you can apply for judicial confirmation to strengthen enforcement.

Time limit for arbitration application: Submit within 1 year from the date of knowing that your rights have been infringed. Please note that attendance records and other evidence may be lost over time, so the procedure should be started as early as possible.

Case: The designer Mr. Chen had a dispute with the company at a salary meeting over the calculation method of project bonuses. He submitted a written request for negotiation before applying for arbitration. The company did not respond, and the arbitration ruled on bonus payment based on the meeting minutes. The entire process took 2 months.

items.title: Look at the rental contract item by item
items.core: Before signing, there is negotiation, and after signing, there is fulfillment.
body: Confirm the rent, deposit, maintenance responsibility and return conditions.
Write verbal promises into supplementary terms.

Focus on checking the cost-bearing terms: clarify who will pay for property fees, heating fees, and network fees, and whether there is a bundled clause that says 'full payment is required regardless of whether it is used or not'.

Division of responsibilities for inspection and maintenance: It is agreed that natural aging of home appliances will be repaired by the landlord, and man-made damage will be borne by the tenant. The time limit for response to repair reports and the rules for advance payment of expenses will be noted.

Confirm the conditions for subletting and withdrawal: indicate 'subletting is possible with the landlord's written consent', as well as the 30-day notice required for early termination and the proportion of liquidated damages deducted.

Case: Tenant Xiao Zhao did not read the contract carefully when signing the contract. After moving in, he discovered that "if you cancel the lease early, you will have to pay 3 months' liquidated damages." He had to move out due to a job change. Because the terms of the contract were clear, he could only pay liquidated damages, resulting in a loss of 12,000 yuan.

items.title: Keep evidence of deposit return
items.core: The status at check-in determines the dispute when checking out.
body: We will take photos and videos during check-in and check-out.
Both parties sign the handover list.

Take a 360-degree video with time watermark when checking in, focusing on recording stains on the wall, scratches on furniture, and the operating status of home appliances. The video must completely include the room number.

Make a handover list and sign it with both parties: List the quantity and functional status of each item, such as 'air conditioning and refrigeration are normal, 2 remote controls' to avoid verbal disputes when checking out.
Pay the deposit via bank transfer and note 'Deposit for renting a house in XX community from X month X to X month X', and keep the transfer voucher and landlord's payment confirmation record.

Case: Tenant Ms. Sun did not take pictures to preserve the condition of the wall when she moved in. When she checked out, the landlord claimed that there were stains and she had to pay 500 yuan in compensation. Ms. Sun could not prove that the walls were clean when she checked in, so a cleaning fee of 300 yuan was eventually deducted from the deposit.

items.title: Consumption vouchers must be kept
items.core: Invoices and orders are the basis for rights protection.
body: Request an invoice for large purchases.
Save the product description and commitment page.

Take the initiative to ask for an electronic invoice when shopping online: check the 'require invoice' when placing an order and fill in the correct header. If you do not receive it within 7 days after receiving the goods, you can contact the platform customer service to force it to be pushed.

Check the receipt information on the spot for offline consumption: confirm that the product name, unit price, and quantity are consistent with the actual product. For catering consumption, special inspection is required to check whether dishes are missed or double billed.

Build a rights protection evidence package: Save order screenshots, chat records, and photos of product problems in chronological order, and use cloud storage backup to prevent the loss of evidence caused by the loss of your mobile phone.

Case: Mr. Wu, a consumer, purchased a washing machine online, but it malfunctioned 3 months later. Because the invoice and order screenshots were not saved, the merchant refused warranty on the grounds of "no proof of purchase," and ultimately spent 800 yuan on repairs at his own expense.

items.title: Online shopping for seven days without any reason or conditions
items.core: Customized, fresh and unpacked audio and video products are usually not applicable.
body: Confirm if the product is an exception.
Keep the item in good condition and retain the packaging.

Exclusions for customized products: engraved jewelry, customized furniture and other products that are 'made according to consumer requirements'. Before placing an order, you must confirm with the merchant in writing whether it accepts returns without reason.

Fresh product acceptance criteria: Immediately unpack and inspect cold chain food upon receipt. If the packaging is damaged or the temperature is abnormal, you must take photos within 2 hours, contact customer service and apply for a refund.

Restrictions on unpacking of audio and video products: Unopened CDs and game discs can be returned, but products with activated serial numbers or scratched-off anti-counterfeiting codes are generally not eligible for return without reason.

Case: After receiving the goods, Ms. Li, the buyer of the customized wardrobe, requested a return due to "size discrepancy", but the merchant refused on the grounds that "customized products are not supported without reason." After the platform intervened, the return application was rejected because the product was customized and had no quality issues.

items.title: You can claim compensation if you encounter counterfeit goods
items.core: Preserving evidence is more effective than arguing on the spot.
body: First fix the product and promotion pages.
Complain through the platform or regulatory authorities.

Stop using fake goods immediately if you find them: Keep the unopened gifts and packaging boxes to avoid cleaning, trimming tags and other actions that change the original condition of the goods and affect the identification results.

Notarization and evidence collection process: Fix the product details page and chat records through the blockchain evidence storage platform, or use the notary office to notarize the purchase process and content.

Compensation standards claim: In addition to refunds, you can ask for compensation three times the price of the goods (less than 500 yuan will be calculated as 500 yuan). If personal injury is caused, you will need to claim additional losses such as medical expenses.

Case: Ms. Zhou purchased "genuine" cosmetics from an unauthorized online store and discovered allergies after using them. She kept the product packaging, chat records and appraisal reports. After complaining to the platform, she received a "refund of one and three indemnity" compensation, totaling 3,200 yuan.

items.title: Verify property rights first
items.core: Not all lessors have the right to rent.
body: Check the property title certificate and ID card.
Confirm whether there is a mortgage or seizure.

Required to produce the original real estate certificate and ID card: Check whether the name of the property owner is consistent. If entrusted to rent, you need to check the notarized power of attorney. Be wary of the 'second landlord' subletting without authorization.

Go to the real estate registration center to check: Bring a copy of the real estate certificate and ID card to check whether the house is mortgaged, seized or has a co-owner to avoid renting a property that is subject to judicial restrictions.

Verify the consent of the co-owners: If the property certificate is registered as jointly owned by multiple people, it is necessary to obtain a written document signed by all co-owners agreeing to rent to prevent subsequent property rights disputes from affecting the residence.

Case: The tenant Mr. Zheng rented a house through an intermediary. After moving in for 3 months, he was asked by the real landlord to move out - the original tenant (second landlord) did not obtain sublet permission. Because the property rights were not verified, Mr. Zheng was forced to move and lost his deposit and half a year's rent.

items.title: Who pays the agency fee must be clearly stated
items.core: Oral agreements are the most likely to cause disputes.
body: Confirm the amount and payer.
The service content is written into the contract.
When renting a house, include the agency fee clause separately in the contract, indicating whether it will be charged to the landlord or the tenant and the specific amount proportion.
Clearly agree on the payment node for the agency fee, such as whether it should be paid in full on the day the lease is signed or in two installments.
If you sign a contract directly with the landlord through an intermediary, you must also indicate in the contract a list of specific services included in the intermediary fee.

Case: When tenant Xiao Li inspected the house, the agent verbally promised the landlord to bear the agency fee. However, after signing the contract, the intermediary came up with a contract requiring Xiao Li to pay half a month's rent as commission. Because there was no written evidence, Xiao Li finally had to admit that he was unlucky and paid 1,200 yuan, and regretted it afterwards.

items.title: Subletting requires the landlord’s consent
items.core: Subletting without authorization may result in the termination of the contract.
body: Obtain written consent.
Confirm new tenant responsibilities.
Before subletting, you must submit a written application to the landlord through a record-keeping method such as WeChat and wait for a clear response and confirmation.
Check carefully whether there is a clause prohibiting subletting in the original lease contract. If so, never sublet without authorization.
Inform the landlord in writing of the new tenant’s identity information and career status, and obtain consent before signing a sublease agreement.

Case: The tenant transferred a two-bedroom apartment to a colleague for a business trip without asking the landlord. The landlord came to the house and found that the stranger was inconsistent with the contract. According to the contract, the tenant terminated the lease and took back the house. The tenant also lost the deposit.

items.title: Maintenance responsibilities should be divided
items.core: Natural loss and man-made damage are different.
body: Record facility status upon check-in.
Agree on the repair process and the party responsible.
When moving in, take photos of the current condition of home appliances and walls to distinguish between natural aging and man-made damage.
Clearly stipulate in the contract who will bear the cost of small repairs, such as setting an amount threshold to determine who is responsible.
When encountering a large equipment failure, you should notify the landlord as soon as possible and keep records to avoid being deemed as a delay and causing further losses.

Case: When tenant Xiao Wang rented a house, the contract did not specify maintenance responsibilities. After moving in, the toilet naturally aged and leaked. The landlord refused to repair it on the grounds of "whoever uses it will maintain it." Xiao Wang had no choice but to advance the repair fee of 800 yuan by himself. Later, because the contract terms were unclear, he sued for compensation and was not fully supported by the court.

items.title: Check the terms for early cancellation
items.core: Liquidated damages are usually written in very specific terms.
body: Confirm notification period and amount.
Try to negotiate a sublease connection.
Read the early cancellation clause carefully when signing the contract, and focus on recording the specific period of how many days in advance you need to notify the landlord.
Confirm the detailed calculation standard for liquidated damages. It should be clear whether it is charged based on the proportion of the remaining lease term or a fixed amount.

If you need to vacate the lease due to special reasons such as job changes, you should proactively find a replacement tenant and negotiate with the landlord for a reduction or exemption of liquidated damages.

Case: The tenant quit the lease two months in advance due to a job transfer. When signing the contract, he did not read the early cancellation clause. He paid one month's rent as liquidated damages as agreed, and also compensated the agency fee. Later, he found out that the rent could be reduced by half after one year of stay.

items.title: Confirm who pays the property fees
items.core: There are hidden costs besides rent.
body: List water, electricity, gas and property.
Settlement of old accounts at handover.
Before signing a contract, directly verify with the property company whether there is any arrears on the property and the current charging standard details.
Clearly list in the terms of the lease contract whether the property fees are borne by the landlord or the tenant and specify the payment period.
Confirm whether there are any other incidental expenses such as garbage removal fees in addition to the rent, and ask the landlord to list all expenses.

Case: When the tenant signed the lease contract, they only negotiated the monthly rent. After moving in, the property management company called upon them to pay half-year property fees and water bills. The landlord claimed that the contract stated that the tenant would be responsible for the rent, and the tenant could only pay more than 2,000 yuan in back.

items.title: Contact a dealer during the warranty period
items.core: Do not pay for repairs yourself first.
body: Keep proof of purchase.
Apply for service according to warranty terms.
When purchasing large items, be sure to ask for a formal invoice and keep it properly. This is a necessary document to start the official warranty process.
As soon as a fault is discovered, contact the brand’s official after-sales service and record the product serial number and fault phenomenon by taking photos or videos.
During the warranty period, do not ask a third party to disassemble and repair the machine without authorization, otherwise the merchant may refuse to perform warranty obligations on this basis.

Case: The washing machine made an abnormal sound when it was dehydrated ten months after purchase. The user disassembled the machine and went to a repair shop to spend 400 yuan. After-sales service, the merchant said that the bearings could be replaced for free during the warranty period, but the warranty was refused after the machine was dismantled privately.

items.title: Be careful with prepayment
items.core: The merchant may close after recharging.
body: Choose short-term small amount.
Keep contracts and payment records.
Before recharging, check the merchant's existence status and whether there are any operating abnormalities through the corporate credit information publicity system.
Try to choose the recharge method with small amounts and multiple times to avoid investing a large amount of money at one time and causing heavy losses to the merchants after they run away.
Verbal preferential promises to merchants must be written on receipts and stamped, and payment records, contracts and other rights protection evidence must be retained.

Case: Parents applied for a two-year swimming card at the community gym and paid it off in one lump sum. Three months later, the store suddenly posted a closure notice. The person in charge lost contact. The remaining more than 10,000 yuan in class hours could not be refunded, so they had to jointly file a complaint.

items.title: The deposit is different from the deposit
items.core: One can be forfeited and the other can be refunded.
body: Confirm the wording before signing.
Written contracts are used for large transactions.
Before signing a contract or making payment, be sure to read the difference between the two keywords written on the receipt: deposit or deposit.
It is clear that the deposit is in the nature of a guarantee. If the payer regrets, it has no right to get it back. If the recipient breaches the contract, double the amount will be returned.
If it is a deposit, it is regarded as an advance payment. If the transaction is unsuccessful, the payer has the right to require the recipient to return the relevant funds in full.

Case: The consumer paid 3,000 yuan when ordering furniture, and the receipt said "deposit". Later, the store ran out of stock and could not deliver the goods. The consumer asked for a refund with the receipt, but the merchant could not withhold the deposit according to the penalty penalty, and finally refunded the full amount.

items.title: Price fraud can be complained
items.core: It is illegal to make up the original price.
body: Screenshot promotion page.
Report to the platform or regulatory authorities.
Keep screenshots or photos of the product’s original price tag when shopping to check whether the merchant is committing fraud by fabricating the original price.
If you find that a merchant first raises prices and then offers discounts, you can call 12315 to complain to the market supervision department and submit relevant price evidence.
Require merchants to issue detailed price tags and charge lists, and confirm that all price tags are true and clear and do not mislead consumers.

Case: A customer bought a jacket after seeing a poster of "Original price 899, current price 399" in a clothing store. After paying, he found that the same style usually sold for 399. He took a screenshot and complained to market supervision. The store was investigated and refunded and compensated.

items.title: Secure the evidence before taking out foreign objects
items.core: Photography is more effective than arguing.
body: Keep the actual product and packaging.
Apply for processing through the platform.
Stop eating immediately when you find a foreign object in the takeout, and take a photo of the foreign object, the takeout packaging and the receipt as a certificate as soon as possible.
Record the unboxing video or the overall unopened video to clearly show the location of foreign objects and takeout order details.
Keep calm and make clear your demands when negotiating with the merchant. If the negotiation fails, you can apply to the platform customer service for intervention with photos and videos.

Case: The user found plastic pieces in the soup while eating takeout. He stopped discarding and took a close-up of the packaging, order and foreign objects, and then saved the chat history. Based on this, the platform quickly refunded and compensated with coupons.

items.title: Check the details of the travel contract
items.core: Itinerary, accommodation, cancellations and changes must be clear.
body: Confirm self-funded items and shopping arrangements.
Save the promotion page.
Require travel contracts to state specific stopping points and shopping store names to avoid vague pending statements on the itinerary.
Carefully check the hotel name and room type standards of your accommodation to confirm whether it includes an independent bathroom and the specific number of days of stay.
Clearly write down the fee deduction ratio for refunds due to personal reasons, and write down the refund standards for different time periods according to gradients.

Case: A tourist signed up for a five-day trip to Yunnan, but the contract only stated "comfortable hotel". Only before departure did he find out that he was arranged to a remote B&B. Since the address and responsibility for cancellations and changes were not specified, only a small amount of compensation could be negotiated during the rights protection process.

items.title: After-sales promises are written down
items.core: Oral promises are difficult to fulfill.
body: Ask the other person to confirm in the chat.
Save the screenshot of the promise.
When purchasing goods, write the return and exchange period and conditions of the sales commitment in the order remarks column and save the screenshot of the page.
If you have a special after-sales agreement, you can ask customer service to send a written commitment letter through official channels to ensure that it is legally binding.
Clearly state the specific consequences of non-performance of after-sales commitments in communication, so that the other party knows the responsibilities and obligations that need to be assumed.

Case: When the customer bought the refrigerator, the seller verbally promised a ten-year warranty and provided installation brackets. After receiving the goods, it was only subject to the manufacturer's one-year warranty. The customer did not have written proof, and the promise was not fulfilled after multiple communications.

items.title: The elements of the IOU must be complete
items.core: Clearness is more important than politeness.
body: Indicate the amount, term, interest and identity information.
Keep the transfer voucher.
The borrower must sign and add his fingerprint, and attach a copy of his ID card to ensure that his identity is true and valid.
The loan amount must be written in both uppercase and lowercase letters to avoid tampering, and the currency and delivery method (transfer/cash) must be specified.
Clearly agree on the repayment date, interest calculation method and overdue liability. It is best to agree that the jurisdictional court shall be the location of the lender.

Case: When a colleague borrowed money, he only wrote "I'm borrowing 50,000 yuan today" but did not write down his ID number and repayment date. Later, the other party delayed the repayment. When the lender sued, it was difficult to prove his identity and deadline, and it took several months to recover the money.

items.title: Be extra careful with guarantees
items.core: Guarantee means repaying someone else’s debt.
body: See clearly whether it is a general warranty or joint and several liability.
Don’t sign if you’re not sure.
Check whether it is a general guarantee or a joint and several guarantee. Joint liability means that the creditor can directly require the guarantor to repay the loan.
Review the authenticity of the main debt, confirm that the purpose of the loan is legal, and avoid providing guarantee for illegal debts such as gambling.
Note that the guarantee period is generally 6 months from the expiration date of the main debt performance period, and the guarantor will be exempt from liability beyond the expiration date.

Case: A friend’s loan required the parties to make a joint liability guarantee, but the parties signed out of favor. The friend overdue the loan after losing his job. The bank directly required the parties to repay the principal and interest, and the salary card was almost frozen.

items.title: Private lending interest rates are capped
items.core: The excess may not be protected.
body: Check the current judicial protection limit.
Record the repaid amounts one by one.
The agreed interest rate shall not exceed four times the one-year LPR at the time the contract is established, and the court will not support the excess.
The total amount of overdue interest, liquidated damages and other charges is also limited to four times the LPR, and cannot exceed the upper limit in disguise.
When the loan contract is established, pay attention to the current LPR value and specify the interest rate calculation standards in the contract.

Case: A colleague borrowed 100,000 yuan with a stipulated annual interest rate of 36%. When the loan was not repaid upon maturity, the lender sued. The court calculated the interest at four times the one-year LPR at that time. The excess amount was not supported and the two parties re-settled according to the legal principal and interest.

items.title: Verify first when facing debt collection
items.core: Confirm the authenticity of the debt and the identity of the debt collector.
body: Require the other party to provide proof of creditor's rights.
Keep call and text message records.
Require the collection personnel to provide their work ID, power of attorney and creditor's rights transfer certificate to confirm their legal identity.
Check whether the debt amount and borrowing time are consistent with your own records, and be wary of fraud or wrong collection.
Contact creditors through official channels for verification, and do not transfer funds to personal accounts easily.

Case: Xiao Wang received a text message claiming to be a debt collection platform, requesting that the money be transferred to a private account within half an hour. He first called the official customer service and checked the contract number. He found that the creditor's rights had been transferred to another company and the account did not match, thus avoiding a mispayment.

items.title: Don’t miss the statute of limitations
items.core: Rights need to be asserted in a timely manner.
body: Note the time your rights were violated.
Course or sue within the statute of limitations.
The ordinary statute of limitations is 3 years, starting from the date when the right holder knew or should have known about the damage to the right and the obligor.
Regularly collect collection through WeChat, SMS, etc. and keep records. The statute of limitations can be interrupted and recalculated for 3 years.
File a lawsuit or apply for arbitration before the statute of limitations expires to avoid losing the right to win.

Case: Zhang lent 30,000 yuan to his neighbor, and only reminded him twice on WeChat within three years after the agreement expired. After the neighbor refused to return the money, he sued based on chat records and transfer vouchers. The court determined that the reminder had interrupted the statute of limitations and ordered repayment.

items.title: Purpose of writing transfer notes
items.core: Remarks can help restore the loan relationship.
body: Indicate the nature of the loan and repayment.
Avoid forwarding without leaving a message.
Remark "loan to XXX" or "repayment received from XXX" when transferring to clarify the nature of the fund transaction.
The remark should include key information such as the borrower’s name and loan date to facilitate future verification.
Avoid writing vague expressions such as "current accounts" and "living expenses" to avoid being unable to prove the loan relationship.

Case: Xiao Li lent 20,000 yuan to a friend, and noted "loan, return at the end of June" when transferring. Later, a friend said it was investment money. Xiao Li proved the loan relationship with notes, chats and repayment commitments, and the court supported the return of the principal.

items.title: Joint borrowing should be specified
items.core: Whoever lends it must write clearly.
body: Confirm the identity of the debtor.
The guarantor shall state separately.
Co-borrowers need to jointly sign the IOU, clarifying their respective loan amounts and repayment responsibilities.
Indicate whether it is joint liability or share liability. Under joint liability, the lender can require any borrower to repay the loan in full.
Attach copies of ID cards and contact information of all co-borrowers to facilitate future repayment.

Case: My cousin and her boyfriend borrowed 200,000 yuan from their parents to buy a house together. The IOU only mentioned my cousin’s name. After the separation, the boyfriend denied the loan. Due to the lack of a joint loan agreement, the parents finally recovered only the portion that the cousin should bear.

items.title: The total cost of installments must be calculated
items.core: Low interest rates do not equal low fees.
body: Calculate the handling fee into the annualized cost.
Compare lump sum repayment plans.
Calculate the annualized interest rate instead of just looking at the monthly rate. The actual annual rate of 0.5% may exceed 10%.
Add all fees such as handling fees, service fees, and deposits to calculate the actual cost of funds.
Compare the total repayment amounts of different platforms and choose the loan plan with the lowest comprehensive capital cost.

Case: Xiao Chen chose "interest-free installment" when buying a mobile phone. Only when he signed the contract did he discover that there were service fees and early repayment penalties. He added up the 12 installments and actually paid nearly 600 yuan more. He switched to a one-time payment and canceled the installments.

items.title: Lending platforms look at qualifications
items.core: The risk of non-compliant platforms is extremely high.
body: Verify the filing and subject information.
Do not make payments to unfamiliar accounts.
Check whether the platform holds a license issued by the financial regulatory authorities, such as a consumer finance company license.
Query the platform operating company’s qualifications and abnormal business records in the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System.
Be wary of unqualified platforms, whose contract terms may violate legal provisions and lack regulatory protection.

Case: Xiao Zhou saw a low-interest loan link in the group. After downloading it, the customer service asked for a deposit first. She couldn't find the platform's financial filing and the company name was inconsistent, so she stopped payment and called the police to avoid being defrauded further.

items.title: Debt restructuring must be in writing
items.core: Oral extensions are easy to repeat.
body: Indicate the new term and amount.
Keep the repayment voucher.
Sign a written extension agreement to clarify the new repayment period, amount and interest rate adjustment plan.
Indicate that the original IOU remains valid or a new IOU is issued to avoid any ambiguity that the debt has been settled.
Require the guarantor to confirm in writing that it will continue to assume the guarantee liability, otherwise the guarantee obligation may be waived.

Case: A self-employed business owner owed 80,000 yuan to his supplier and verbally agreed to defer the payment for three months and pay less interest. Later, the supplier changed managers and still pressed for payment according to the original contract. After both parties signed a written extension agreement, the new repayment plan was implemented.

items.title: There is a time limit for enforcement
items.core: You must apply in time after the judgment takes effect.
body: Record effective date.
Understand the property inspection and control process.
The period for applying for enforcement is 2 years, starting from the last day of the performance period specified in the legal document.
Apply as soon as possible after the judgment takes effect to avoid being unable to execute due to the transfer of property by the person subject to execution.
Provide property clues of the person subject to execution, such as bank account, real estate, vehicle and other information when applying.

Case: After receiving the effective judgment, Zhao thought that the other party would take the initiative to repay the loan, so he delayed applying for execution for more than two years. The court refused to accept the application on the grounds that the application for execution had exceeded the deadline, so he could only negotiate separately, making it more difficult to collect the money.

items.title: Understand the threshold of property preservation
items.core: Prevent the other party from transferring assets.
body: Prepare preliminary evidence.
Understand the warranty requirements.
To apply for property preservation before or during litigation, preliminary evidence must be provided to prove that the other party has signs of transferring property.
Courts usually require security, which can be in the form of cash, real estate, or a letter of guarantee from an insurance company.
You will be held liable for compensation for errors in preservation, and you need to carefully evaluate your likelihood of winning the case before applying.

Case: Before suing, Sun discovered that the debtor was selling cars and was worried about transferring the property. He provided clues, guaranteed and paid fees to apply for pre-litigation preservation. The court seized the vehicle and the subsequent judgment was successfully executed after it took effect.

items.title: Small claims litigation is more time-saving
items.core: The process is simplified when the subject matter is small.
body: Confirm if applicable.
Prepare complete evidence.

First check the subject amount threshold of small claims announced by this court that year. If the amount is lower than the threshold, the first instance will be final and no further appeals will be allowed.
Number contracts, orders, transfers, reconciliations, and reminders by time, and only talk about the amount, delivery facts, and the other party's breach of contract during the court session.
Don’t be absent after receiving the small claims notice. Evidence, jurisdictional objections and defense opinions must be submitted within the court’s time limit.

Case: Ms. Lin was owed 5,000 yuan by her former colleague. The evidence was clear and the amount was not large. She submitted materials according to the small claims procedure, and the court pronounced the verdict in court after a single hearing, and she got the effective verdict within a few weeks.

items.title: The chain of evidence must be complete
items.core: Isolated screenshots have limited proving power.
body: Keep the original vector.
Arranged in chronological order.
Keep the original mobile phone and original account, don’t just keep the forwarded pictures; the original records, search process and complete context can be shown in court.

The screenshots should include the other party’s nickname, account number, date, and previous and subsequent conversations, and should correspond to the contract, transfer, invoice, and logistics order item by item.
Compile the evidence catalog, write clearly what facts each material proves, who obtained it, and when it was formed. Submit it according to time number.

Case: The lender only saved a screenshot of the WeChat transfer and was unable to explain the nature of the money when suing. The other party argued that it was payment for goods. After the lender added the IOU, chat records and collection recordings, the evidence corroborated each other and the case was won.

items.title: Recording evidence must be obtained legally
items.core: A recording that infringes on the privacy of others may be invalid.
body: Record conversation background and identity.
Keep the original file.
Try to record the negotiations or calls you participate in, and start by confirming the identity and date. The content focuses on the fact of arrears, commitments or breach of contract.
Do not place monitors in other people’s houses or cars, and do not hack accounts to secretly record private conversations. Illegal access will be excluded.
Save the original recording file and the original carrier of the mobile phone, and attach a verbatim transcript to mark key time points. Do not edit or submit only fragments.

Case: Zhang suspected that his colleague would not repay the loan and installed a voice recorder on the bottom of his car at night to record a private conversation. The recording was submitted when suing. The court believed that the evidence collection method violated privacy and did not admit this piece of evidence.

items.title: Do not delete chat records
items.core: They may become key evidence in the future.
body: Back up important conversations.
Keep the account and original device.
After a dispute occurs, first disable automatic cleaning and replacement of old and new messages, and retain the original mobile phone and original account login status.
During backup, the screen recording slides from the friend profile page to the key conversation, showing the avatar, account number, date and continuous context.
Mark key statements such as commitment, payment, acceptance, reminder, etc. in yellow and make a separate list. When submitting, explain the corresponding relationship with the contract or transfer.

Case: When Xiaolin checked out the rent, he confirmed the deposit return date with the landlord on WeChat. Later, he cleared his phone and deleted the chat. After the landlord repented, Xiaolin relied on cloud backup to restore the records and successfully got back the deposit.

items.title: A reminder can interrupt the statute of limitations
items.core: It is important to assert your rights in a timely manner.
body: Use a traceable method to warn.
Save proof of delivery.
Send a written reminder before the expiration of the statute of limitations, specifying the contract date, amount owed and payment period. It is better to retain the other party's reply.
Send the reminder letter in a way that can be checked for delivery, mark the "dunning notice" on the face sheet, and keep the receipt, signature record and copy of the letter.
WeChat or SMS reminders are sent to the account number used by the other party. Avoid just saying "remember to pay back the money" without the amount, basis and deadline.

Case: Wang lent 30,000 yuan to a friend, but the statute of limitations was almost up and he still has not paid it back. He used WeChat to clearly call for payment before the statute of limitations expired and saved the reply. When he later sued, the court determined that the statute of limitations was interrupted and the debt still needed to be repaid.

items.title: The mediation agreement must be signed
items.core: The mediation results are also binding.
body: Clear the performance deadline.
Apply for judicial confirmation when necessary.
Check the amount, performance period, payment account and responsible person before signing, and verbal concessions must also be written into the terms.
The court mediation letter has the same effect as the judgment after it is signed. If one party fails to perform, it can directly apply for compulsory execution.
Both parties shall jointly apply for judicial confirmation within thirty days. After the ruling is confirmed, if the other party refuses to perform, it may directly apply for enforcement.

Case: Water leaked upstairs and damaged the floor of the Chen family. During community mediation, the upstairs family verbally agreed to compensate, but the Chen family did not let the other party sign. Afterwards, the other party regretted it, so the Chen family could only re-mediate and sign a written agreement before the compensation could be implemented.

items.title: Secure evidence at the accident scene first
items.core: Taking pictures and calling the police is more useful than arguing.
body: The shooting scene, license plate and injury.
Call the police promptly and obtain accident identification.

First turn on the double flashers and place the triangle sign, and then take pictures of the panorama, collision site, license plate and traffic signal after confirming that there is no risk of secondary accidents.

Before moving the vehicle, take photos and videos from front, rear, left, right, and multiple angles, record the time and location, and take photos of the driver's license, driving license, and insurance policy.
Call the police immediately and obtain the accident number. If someone is injured, call an ambulance immediately. Also note down the phone number and monitoring location of the witness.

Case: Two cars were bumping into each other at the gate of a community, and the two sides were fighting over who could change lanes first. Ms. Li did not continue to argue, took pictures of the vehicle's location, scratches and surrounding license plates, and immediately called the police. The traffic police quickly determined the blame based on photos and surveillance.

items.title: There is a time limit for work-related injury recognition
items.core: The earlier you apply, the easier it is to verify.
body: Preserve evidence of labor relations and injuries.
Submit the application within the specified time.
The employer should usually apply within thirty days from the date of the accident injury. If the employer fails to report the time, the individual can apply on his own within one year.
First save attendance, shift schedules, work badges, salary statements, and location and call records on the day of the accident to prove working hours and reasons.
When seeking medical treatment, truthfully explain the injury, and keep medical records, diagnosis certificates, imaging films, and invoices for subsequent appraisal and reimbursement.

Case: Zhao injured his finger while operating a cutting machine in the factory. His employer advised him to recuperate first, but he delayed applying for work-related injury recognition until one year and two months. Because the application deadline has passed, the Human Resources and Social Security Department has not accepted the application.

items.title: There is a time limit for labor arbitration
items.core: Labor disputes cannot be applied for indefinitely.
body: The calculation starts from the time when you know that your rights have been infringed.
Try to negotiate first but don’t push past the deadline.
Usually apply for back wages, compensation, etc. within one year from the time you know your rights have been infringed. Don’t wait until long after you leave your job to settle old debts.

Wages in arrears during the duration of the labor relationship can be dealt with specially, but demands must be made as soon as possible and within one year after resignation and a record of reminders must be kept.
The application clearly states the requested amount, calculation method and evidence list. If you are not satisfied with the decision, you will usually file a lawsuit within 15 days.

Case: The company owed Xiao Zhou three months’ salary. He was busy looking for a job after leaving his job, and it took two years before he applied for labor arbitration. The arbitration committee considered that the statute of limitations exceeded one year and rejected his request for wage recovery.

items.title: You can file a complaint if personal information is leaked
items.core: Reserve the right to claim evidence of leakage.
body: Screenshots of leaked pages and propagation paths.
Report to the platform or regulatory authorities.
First take screenshots to save the leaked page, text messages, email headers, sending numbers and URLs, and record the screen to show the account, time and propagation path.
Submit a complaint to the platform and request deletion, blocking, or stop providing information. Save the work order number and reply for secondary reporting.
When harassment, fraud or large-scale sales are involved, you can report it to the Internet Information Network, market supervision, public security or 12321 and attach a directory of evidence.

Case: After Ms. Liu applied for a fitness card, she received a precise sales call and was able to tell the time to apply for the card. She saved screenshots of the call records and card application receipts, and complained to the regulatory authorities. The gym was asked to delete the information and stop spreading it.

items.title: Likeness and voice cannot be misused
items.core: Commercial use usually requires personal consent.
body: Get evidence first if you find theft.
Request the platform to be removed from the shelves and reserve the right to pursue liability.
If you find that merchants use photos to make posters, detail pages or short videos to promote goods, record the screen first to save the link, release time and sales volume.
When replying, clearly state that you do not agree to continue commercial use. Do not write words such as 'use as you like' that can easily be misinterpreted as authorization.
Sounds are synthesized for use in advertising or customer service speech, and original sound samples, comparison audios and infringement page complaints are also submitted to the platform.

Case: A milk tea shop cut a photo of customer Xiao Chen’s smiling face and order voice into a short promotional video and hung it on the store screen to attract traffic. After Xiao Chen found out, he asked for it to be removed from the shelves, and the store compensated and deleted the material.

items.title: Marriage property can be agreed upon
items.core: Clear agreement can reduce future disputes.
body: Distinguish between pre-marital and post-marital property.
Important agreements shall be in writing.
Sign a written agreement before or during marriage to list the source of real estate, vehicles, deposits, equity and mortgage repayments. Don’t just write down general ownership.

The agreement states the down payment before marriage, loan repayment after marriage, value-added part and the registered party. Major assets are accompanied by property rights certificates, statements or appraisal sheets.

Both parties signed and stamped it and each kept a copy. When it comes to real estate transfer, it should be registered in a timely manner. The agreement can be notarized to enhance the evidentiary power.

Case: The man’s parents contributed money to buy a house before marriage, but the woman was worried about unclear rights and interests. The two people sign a written property agreement, specifying the source of down payment, loan repayment method and compensation rules. When they divorced a few years later, the parties divided according to the agreement and there were few disputes.

items.title: Inheritance procedures must be completed according to procedures
items.core: Only with complete materials can the transfer be completed smoothly.
body: Confirm the scope of will or legal heirs.
Prepare death certificate and kinship documents.

First, go to the police station where the deceased is registered to issue a death certificate, and go to the neighborhood committee or file storage unit to get proof of kinship. Any missing item may be rejected.

The transfer of real estate requires the presence and signature of all legal heirs; if someone renounces inheritance, a written renunciation statement must be issued and notarized, and cannot be said verbally.

After obtaining the notarized certificate of inheritance rights, go to the real estate registration center to apply for transfer registration. Do not sell the house first and then complete the formalities, as this may easily lead to contract disputes.

Case: After his father passed away, his son wanted to inherit the house, but he only took his will to the real estate registration center, but it was returned due to lack of death certificate and kinship documents. After completing the materials, the house was successfully transferred.

items.title: Find professional help when needed
items.core: Complex problems are not suitable for searching alone.
body: Learn about legal aid channels.
Bring complete materials when consulting.

When it comes to issues such as real estate disputes, company equity, cross-border taxation, etc., you should entrust a licensed lawyer or accountant, and don’t just read fragmentary answers in online articles.

Arrange the contract, transfer records, and chat screenshots in chronological order before consulting, which can greatly shorten the time for lawyers to understand the case and reduce consultation fees.

If you are unsure about oral advice, ask for a written legal opinion; at the same time, check the lawyer's practice status through the official website of the Bureau of Justice to avoid encountering fake lawyers.

Case: Mr. Zheng checked many online templates due to a company equity dispute, and the prosecution materials were repeatedly returned. After consulting a lawyer, he organized the evidence and claims according to the lawyer's opinions, resubmitted and successfully filed the case.

items.title: Keep your ID number safe
items.core: Leakage of identity information will cause trouble.
body: Do not take photos and send them out at will.
Mark the purpose of the copy.
The copy of the ID card must be marked "Only for ×× business, re-copying is invalid", written in blue pen and pressed against the edge of the ID card to prevent it from being cut or stolen.

Don’t send photos of the front and back of your ID card on unfamiliar websites or in groups; hide the middle digits of the number when shipping by express delivery, and don’t write your full name when making delivery notes.

If your ID card is lost, go to the nearest police station to report the loss as soon as possible and get a replacement. At the same time, pay attention to whether the bank card and mobile phone card have been reissued under someone else's name, and freeze it if necessary.

Case: Xiaolin sent the ID photo to the front desk when checking in, and then left it in the chat history. After the phone was sent for repair, the repairman found it and the other party tried to register for a loan. The platform risk control intercepted the phone and Xiaolin called the police and changed the relevant password.

items.title: Personal information is only given to the necessary scope
items.core: Excessive collection can be rejected.
body: Ask for usage and shelf life.
Reject information not related to business.

When registering the APP, only fill in your mobile phone number and nickname. If you encounter someone who is forced to ask for your ID number and address book permissions, ask for the legal basis first, and you can refuse and give up the registration.

Shopping malls and gyms ask for birthdays, home addresses, etc., and you don’t have to fill them in unless necessary; if the other party insists, ask for a privacy policy and indicate the scope of use.

Don’t use facial recognition if you can, give priority to password or SMS verification; when you really need to scan your face, confirm it is a formal institution and ask about the data retention period on the spot.

Case: Ms. Wang scanned the QR code at the mall to receive a trial lesson. The form required her to fill in her address, work unit and child’s school. She only left her mobile phone number and crossed out the redundant items. The clerk agreed and gave her an experience coupon. She avoided the information being used for precise sales.

items.title: Permission required for use of portrait
items.core: Commercial use usually requires consent.
body: Get evidence first if you find theft.
Request removal and reserve the right to pursue liability.

Businessmen who want to use your photos for posters or short videos must sign a written authorization, specifying the platform, region and period of use. It is difficult to prove it after verbal agreement.
When authorizing, clarify whether it can be sublicensed or modified to avoid the photo being sold to a third party for a second time; the amount and payment method must be agreed upon for paid use.
If you find that the photo has been stolen, first notarize the product page and release time or save a credible timestamp, then contact the platform to remove it and claim compensation.

Case: Zhang attended an event in a coffee shop. The clerk took a photo of her toasting and used it as a door advertisement. After she found out, she asked for authorization records, but the store couldn't provide them, so they immediately took down the poster and apologized.

items.title: Get evidence first if your reputation is damaged
items.core: Save screenshots and links.
body: Record the publishing time and account number.
Require the platform to take necessary measures.
When you see a defamatory post, record the entire screen first, including the account homepage, posting time, and reading volume. A single screenshot can easily be questioned and cropped.

Save the complete link of the post and the UID of the publisher, complain to the platform and request the disclosure of real-name information, and prepare the defendant's subject information for subsequent prosecution.

If the insult is serious and spreads widely, you can directly go to court to sue for reputation infringement; if it involves threats, call the police and conduct an injury or psychological evaluation simultaneously.

Case: Ms. Li was accused of accepting kickbacks in a post on a community forum. She first saved the web link, screenshots and posting time, and then contacted the platform to complain. After the post was taken down, the person who posted it privately apologized and stopped spreading it.

items.title: Domestic Violence Can Help
items.core: This is not a family matter.
body: Call the police and seek medical treatment promptly.
Preserve evidence of injuries and recordings.

If you are beaten, tied up, or have your personal freedom restricted, call 110 immediately to call the police and ask for a report receipt. This is key evidence for subsequent applications for a personal safety protection order.

Go to a regular hospital for injury examination in a timely manner, and save medical records, X-rays and payment receipts; photos of the injury should be taken of the entire face and bruise locations, and bring the day's newspaper for time reference.
You can seek help from the women’s federation, neighborhood committee or labor union at your place of residence. They can help contact shelters and free legal aid. Don’t bear the burden alone.

Case: Ms. Chen was pushed and threatened by her drunk husband. She took her children and hid in a neighbor's house. She immediately called 110 and contacted the Women's Federation. The police went out and made a record, and the Women's Federation helped her consult about asylum and medical treatment. She subsequently applied for a protection order.

items.title: Understand the process of personal safety protection order
items.core: You can apply when there is actual danger.
body: Prepare dangerous evidence.
Make an application to the court.

There is no prerequisite for filing for divorce when applying for a personal safety protection order. As long as there is a real danger, you can submit an application directly to the grassroots court with jurisdiction.
Prepare evidence such as alarm records, photos of injuries, threatening text messages, etc. After review, the court will generally make a ruling within 72 hours, and in emergencies within 24 hours.

The ruling is valid for no more than 6 months, and you can apply for revocation or change before it expires; if the other party violates the ban, call the police immediately and the public security organs will assist in enforcement.

Case: Before Ms. Zhou’s divorce, her ex-husband blocked the door many times. She saved the recordings, monitoring and alarm receipts, and wrote an application to apply for a personal safety protection order from the court in the place of residence. After accepting the case, the court made a ruling prohibiting access.

items.title: Guardianship responsibilities have boundaries
items.core: Guardianship does not mean arbitrary disposal of property.
body: Act in the interests of the ward.
Leave records of major punishments.

Guardians can only dispose of property for the benefit of the ward, such as paying tuition and medical expenses; proof of reasonable use must be provided when buying and selling real estate, otherwise other relatives may sue.

The New Year’s money and inheritance income of minors should be managed in separate accounts. If they are mixed into the guardian’s own account, it will be deemed as misappropriation, and may also be recovered during divorce and division.

The guardianship situation can be regularly understood through neighborhood committees and schools; if the guardian fails to perform his duties, other close relatives can apply to the court to change the guardianship relationship.

Case: The father, Mr. Zhang, as the guardian of his mentally disabled son, sold the property worth 800,000 yuan in his son's name to relatives without authorization at a low price. The court determined that the behavior was not for the benefit of the ward and ruled that the sale was invalid. Mr. Zhang must return the house payment and bear compensation liability.

items.title: Adoption must be handled according to procedures
items.core: There are legal risks in private adoption.
body: Confirm whether you meet the conditions.
Apply through the civil affairs department.

Adoption must be registered with the civil affairs department at or above the county level. First, apply for evaluation, submit ID card, health certificate and adoption application form. Private adoption cannot be registered.

The adoptee generally needs to be under 14 years old; if you pick up an abandoned baby, you must first call the police and obtain a finding certificate and announcement. You cannot directly take it home and raise it as your own child.

The adoption relationship is established from the date of registration, and household registration will be done with the adoption registration certificate thereafter; if it is not registered, the rights and obligations of parents and children do not arise legally.

Case: A couple privately adopted a friend's newborn. They only wrote an adoption agreement. When the child was registered, they were informed that the procedures were incomplete. Later, they went to the civil affairs department to undergo evaluation and registration before completing the legal adoption.

items.title: Pre-marital property can be stipulated
items.core: Clearly agreed upon to reduce future disputes.
body: Distinguish between pre-marital and post-marital property.
In writing.

Pre-marital property agreements must be in writing, oral promises are invalid; specific information such as the location of the property, parking space, and deposit account number can be listed, and a copy of the property ownership certificate can be attached.
