After both parties sign, it is recommended to have it notarized. Although it is also valid without notarization, the notarization will have stronger probative power in subsequent disputes and can reduce the trouble of proof.

The content of the agreement must be fair and cannot restrict the basic rights of the other party. For example, clauses such as "cleanse and leave the house upon filing for divorce" may be deemed invalid because they violate public order and good customs.

Case: Ms. Liu purchased a property worth 2 million in full before marriage, but did not make any property agreement after marriage. During the divorce, the husband claimed that the increased value of the house was the joint property of the couple. Due to the lack of a written agreement, the court finally ruled that Ms. Liu should compensate her husband for the increased value of 300,000 yuan.

items.title: Use the cooling-off period in divorce
items.core: to give both parties time to think about it.
body: Sort out the focus of controversy.
Consult professionals if necessary.

During the cooling-off period, either party can withdraw the application. If you don’t want to divorce, you can go to the marriage registration office to withdraw it in time; if you want to divorce, both parties must come together to collect the marriage certificate within 30 days after the expiration of the period.

Use this time to sort out the list of real estate, deposits, and debts, and list each person's pre-marital and post-marital share, so as to avoid going to the Civil Affairs Bureau to fight for property, which may lead to failure.

If you have children, you can first negotiate the custody rights, visitation time and the amount of child support into a written plan. During the cooling-off period, you can also ask a lawyer or mediator to intervene in the negotiation.

Case: A couple filed for divorce due to a dispute over decoration. During the cooling-off period, they wrote down a list of the disputes, made an appointment with a counselor and communicated with both parents. Before the expiration, they jointly withdrew the application and decided to separate and try to live together.

items.title: Custody depends on the interests of the child
items.core: It does not belong to whoever wants it.
body: Prepare evidence of caregiving ability.
Respect the expression of the child's wishes.
In principle, children under the age of 2 belong to their mother. Unless the mother is seriously ill, abused, or otherwise unfit to be raised, the child can be assigned to the father.
The court will solicit the opinions of children over 8 years old, and the child's clearly expressed wish to live together is an important reference for the judgment.

The party who takes care of the child's daily life, helps with homework, and accompanies him to medical treatment for a long time is more likely to be recognized by the judge in the custody competition.

Case: When a couple divorced, they both fought for the custody of their eight-year-old daughter. The judge looked at the transcript, medical records and school opinions and found that the child had been cared for by the mother for a long time. The child was eventually awarded to the mother, and the father paid monthly support and visited weekly.

items.title: The obligation to support cannot be exempted
items.core: Parents have the right to demand necessary living expenses.
body: Clarify the sharing method.
Keep payment records.

Even if a "severance of parent-child relationship" agreement is signed, the agreement is invalid because it violates the mandatory provisions of the law, and the child still has to bear the obligation to support.
Alimony must cover the parents’ basic living and medical expenses. If the parents become disabled, they must also bear nursing expenses or personal care responsibilities.

The parents have failed to fulfill their support obligations, and the children cannot refuse to pay alimony on this basis. The law only supports reducing the amount based on the specific circumstances.

Case: Lao Zhou signed a "disconnection agreement" with his son when he was young. Later, he fell ill and had no income, and asked his son to bear the medical expenses and living expenses. The court held that the agreement could not exempt the child from support obligations and ordered the son to pay necessary fees on a monthly basis.

items.title: The form of the will must be in compliance with regulations
items.core: Defects in the form may lead to invalidity.
body: Understand the requirements for self-writing, writing on behalf of others and notarization.
Keep the originals and tell them the clues.
A self-written will must be written in full, signed and marked with the year, month and day. If it is printed and signed, it will be invalid because it does not meet the formal requirements.
The will must be signed by more than 2 disinterested witnesses, and one of them must sign on behalf of the will. Both the witnesses and the testator must sign and date the will.
The audio and video will needs to record the portraits and voices of the testator and more than 2 witnesses. A will that does not record the images of witnesses will not be legally effective.

Case: The old man printed out the contents of the will, only signed and dated it at the end, and did not let the two witnesses sign page by page. After the old man passed away, his children sued for the property, and the court determined that the will was invalid due to irregularities in form.
